copy.question: Can we make the washed garden path trustworthy before the next visitor?
copy.notice_instruction: Notice what the rain has changed; the first useful lead is guaranteed.
copy.follow_lead_instruction: Follow the rain-bright lead east to Rain-Soft Garden.
copy.contribute_instruction: Inspect the buried stones, clear the drain, or help another traveler lift them.
copy.complete_instruction: The first stones are visible. A lamp-road marker beyond them points west toward Mossbell and the Wayside Lantern Inn.
copy.target_label: the washed path in Rain-Soft Garden
copy.consequence: The first stones will give the next visitor an honest footing and reveal a lead toward the lantern road.
copy.completion_memory: You checked the garden path and left the next visitor a marked stone.
copy.next_invitation: Follow the lamp road west to Mara Wick and learn why the Mothwood beacon went dark.
copy.public_trace: left Rati a record of a marked garden stone, so the next guest can find their footing

continuation.travel_instruction: Follow the lamp road west through Mossbell Inn to the Wayside Lantern Inn.
continuation.arrival_instruction: Find Mara Wick at the empty key hook and hear what failed along the Mothwood road.
continuation.accepted_instruction: Mara entrusts you with the dark-road lead: follow the failed lamps and rekindle the Mothwood beacon.

presentation.title: A path for Rati’s next guest
presentation.premise: Rain has swallowed the stepping stones outside Rati’s cottage. Her next guest needs a safe way through the garden. Find the path, choose how to help, and leave a stone marked for the next traveler.
presentation.recognition: Rati’s cottage record keeps your name beside the marked stone. Your help is part of the path’s story.
